components.name: Refresh button
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #394148;border-radius:7px;background:#24292e;color:#e0e6ea;font:12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button:hover{background:#30383e;border-color:#56616b;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8de0cd;outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out;}}

components.name: Quiet button
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #394148;border-radius:7px;background:#24292e;color:#e0e6ea;font:12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;cursor:pointer;}.ds-button:hover{background:#30383e;border-color:#56616b;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #8de0cd;outline-offset:4px;}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-button{transition:background-color 150ms ease-out;}}.ds-quiet{background:transparent;border-color:transparent;color:#a0a9b2;}

narrative.overview:
The client and administrator dashboards share a sleek, modern dark shell for unreel content’s private, read-only metrics workspace. Charcoal surfaces, restrained mint accents, clear totals and readable reports extend the user’s chosen direction. This is a code-led record of the delivered application, not a broader brand identity.

The shared shell covers / and /admin; default reports and invitation/connection pages are also dark. Custom project designs remain authoritative inside data-project-theme. Product context comes from README.md; no PRODUCT.md or additional interview decisions are assumed.
keyCharacteristics: Shared charcoal shell and authentic unreelviews logo.
Dark default reports with authoritative custom project designs.
Persistent desktop collapse and accessible mobile modal navigation.

rules.name: The Project Boundary Rule
rules.body: Apply default report styles only outside data-project-theme; saved project designs remain authoritative.

rules.name: The Visible State Rule
rules.body: Preserve visible focus, written status and keyboard-accessible scrolling.

dos: Do share shell behavior across client and administrator views.
Do preserve visible focus, explicit status text, accessible table labels and tabular numbers.
Do reuse the authentic logo and authored SVG navigation icons.
donts: Don’t override saved project designs with default report styling.
Don’t imply that read-only dashboard controls edit business data.
